name: EVENTIDE
source:
The ocean threatens to consume you from the inside out. The Institute offers you a cure – but at the cost of your humanity… or so they say. Maybe you’ll just look different. Maybe you’ll never be able to look at your reflection again. Maybe you’ll turn into a monster after all.

Maybe your humanity is yours to make.

Either way, your life is on the line. It’s your choice what to do with it.

[From [url=https://killjoyconstruct.itch.io/eventide]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
海洋可能会从内到外吞噬你。该研究所为你提供了一种治疗方法——但代价是你的人性……至少他们是这么说的。也许你会看起来不一样。也许你永远无法再看到自己的倒影。也许你最终会变成怪物。

也许你的人性是你自己创造的。

无论哪种方式，你的生命都处于危险之中。如何处理它是你的选择。

[来自[url=https://killjoyconstruct.itch.io/eventide]itch.io[/url]]
